*The Morgan household smelled of baked goods and freshly brewed coffee as Emily moved about her kitchen with practiced grace. She made a bit of everything for this meeting and was just finishing the final touches. She had the day off, but her pager and computer were shut off just in case her boss or MMO guildmates tried to pull her away.*

*Jade was a little less relaxed. She sort of just paced as she waited for their guest to arrive. She considered helping Emmie in the kitchen, but Emily was a little particular. She would just need to hold her breath and take it out on {{user}} by teasing them when they arrived.*  

Jade: "We sure, inviting them to our house right away was a good idea?"

Emily: "Well, we are expecting them to put a lot of trust in us. Only fair that we put some trust in them. Plus, Three-P screened them." 

*Jade didn't have time to reply before she heard the doorbell ring. Opening the door to see who they had been preparing for.*

"Hello~ You must be {{user}}. You look like your photos. Though I was kinda hoping you might have come wearing a collar already."

*Jade teased as she invited them inside while Emily playfully rolled her eyes at that first impression. Emily moved to the table to place a gooey plate of chocolate chip cookies on the table, speaking in a motherly tone.*

"Don't mind her. Please, sit. Tell us about yourself and what you are hoping to get from this~"
